title: thymus hispanicus var. longiflorus
intro: Thymus hispanicus var. longiflorus, commonly known as Spanish thyme, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is a type of flowering plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of T. hispanicus var. longiflorus include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
